scope: Offline static tracing of listed installed command entrypoints. Family identifies the parser implementation, and formatter_family records specific formatter or dispatch variants. These are not runtime output checks or final split assignments. Alternate entrypoints only share the cited classification when listed under commands_traced.
evidence_method: Installed source read as data via the Python standard library in the pinned images, with no app imports or executions. Recorded AST symbols omit content strings and preserve file paths, line numbers, and SHA-256 of exact source files. No help captures, annotations, predictions, man pages, or completion contents read.
ancestry_notes: pip-tools exposes Click commands, and calls pip internal commands and parser code for package management. pip exposes its own optparse CLI. pipenv exposes vendored Click and ships patched pip. These repositories should be considered together when screening ancestry overlap.
Visual formatter variants for HTTPie, rich-cli, and HTTPX reflect project-specific Rich integration. This survey does not assign them to the rich-click package family.
Invoke and Fabric share Invoke Program and parser code. Datasette and LLM both use click-default-group on top of Click.
AWS CLI command help has a separate documentation renderer. Docutils front controller and publisher have separate parser implementations. Review each invocation scope before grouping help formatters.

projects.limitations: Entry wrapper calls the Click-decorated main. blackd is a distinct entrypoint and was outside this trace.
Root parser and several subparsers explicitly select LineWrapRawTextHelpFormatter.

The root PipenvGroup subclasses vendored Click Group and wraps context-generated help in its own format_help. The wheel also contains patched pip, which is a shared ancestry risk, and pipenv-resolver is a separate entrypoint.
ToxParser subclasses an argparse wrapper that incorporates environment and config values. tox plugin hooks augment the parser and subcommands can select tox's HelpFormatter.
The entry wrapper reaches a programmatically built VirtualEnvConfigParser with a custom defaults formatter and component registration.

The http and https entrypoints share HTTPieArgumentParser. Its print_manual uses argparse format_help, then outputs through a Rich pager. The httpie management entrypoint is a separate CLI and was not equated with http.
RichCommand subclasses Click Command and overrides format_help to render Rich Console and Table objects. This is project-specific Click plus Rich code.
The executable targets the Click-decorated CLI group. Other SQLFluff formatting code is separate from root help wiring.
main invokes the Click group hatch and the group registers additional commands.
Root command uses the click-default-group wrapper. The serve command also creates a Click HelpFormatter explicitly. Additional plugin commands can modify the command graph.
Entry goes through pytest_cmdline_parse hooks and PytestArgumentParser. Root help invokes the argparse parser; installed plugins can add options.
CoverageOptionParser and its GlobalOptionParser and CmdOptionParser subclasses use custom multi-paragraph formatting. Versioned aliases target main_deprecated.
Poetry subclasses Cleo Application, invokes it at the entrypoint, and sets its output styles. Cleo parses argv and supplies the help command.
ansible targets AdHocCLI and its shared parser factory specifies SortingHelpFormatter. The wheel installs multiple independent front ends, including ansible-test, and they were not all traced.

The installed aws script calls awscli.clidriver.main, which creates MainArgParser. Explicit help is dispatched through a separate HelpCommand renderer. Treat parser heritage and observed-format eligibility separately.
projects.entrypoint_provenance: The distribution has no console_scripts entry for aws. Evidence traces the installed bin/aws script.

projects.limitations: Entrypoint passes into the custom optparse ConfigOptionParser. Root and subcommands use UpdatingDefaultsHelpFormatter. pip internals are reused by pip-tools and pipenv vendors patched pip.

Both public commands are Click commands with a custom Click help option. They reuse pip internals for dependency and install operations, so different public parser families do not remove ancestry concerns.
The entry main directly constructs and parses an argparse parser.
The entry module reexports the Click-decorated main.
The console entry directly targets a Click group. ColorFormatter in the same module is logging-related.
The ordinary sphinx-build path reaches the stdlib parser. Alternate make mode and separately installed front ends were not used to assign this family.
The docutils front controller uses argparse for initial routing while its publisher and rst2html use Docutils' optparse parser and TitledHelpFormatter. Family denotes the front controller only.
The main mypy executable reaches CapturableArgumentParser with AugmentedHelpFormatter. Distinct entrypoints such as dmypy are outside this trace.
The entry calls PylintRun, which initializes a plugin-capable argument manager. That manager uses argparse and a custom formatter.
Main delegates to construction and use of a stdlib ArgumentParser. The auxiliary identify-imports command has a distinct parser.
The single-file distribution defines the executable target and builds its argparse parser directly.
The entry creates Application. Preliminary parsing and its plugin-aware OptionManager both use argparse.
Main directly constructs argparse with RawDescriptionHelpFormatter and parses its options. Other console scripts were not used to assign the family.
The entry function builds and invokes its argparse parser.
The entry reexports _script_main, which reaches parse_options and a local ArgumentParser subclass with NewlineHelpFormatter.
main delegates to Twine's argparse dispatch, which parses before calling the selected subcommand.
entrypoint calls main, which builds its parser via a partial of argparse.ArgumentParser with RawDescriptionHelpFormatter.
The installed main calls the parser factory and uses its argparse parse and help methods.
The entry reexports nox_main. It uses a typed Options wrapper backed by argparse. The tox-to-nox converter is outside this trace.
The console target is a Program.run bound method. Invoke supplies its own Parser and ParseMachine, and Program renders its help. Fabric shares Invoke ancestry.
The console target is Fab.run inherited from Invoke Program. It shares Invoke's parser and formatter ancestry.
The entry constructs a local argparse subclass and format_help override. Its option set is grouped by the project's parser and can include plugin options.
The entry reexports a Click command, whose custom help callback calls the project Rich renderer instead of Click's default help option. This is project-specific Click plus Rich code.
Root Click group uses click-default-group. Plugins can extend the command graph.
main delegates to parse_options, whose factory makes the custom optparse class. The parser initializes a custom indented HelpFormatter and incorporates configuration.
